claim_as_used_in_script: South Asia's Gyps vultures fell by more than 95 percent in about a decade
notes: Prakash et al. 2003 cited in Green et al. 2004

claim_as_used_in_script: The white-rumped vulture fell by as much as 99.9 percent
The cause was diclofenac, a cheap painkiller given to cattle; vultures feeding on treated carcasses died of kidney failure
India banned veterinary diclofenac in 2006
In 2023 India banned two more vulture-killing drugs, ketoprofen and aceclofenac, for animals
Without vultures, carcasses took about twice as long to decompose and flies nearly doubled (Costa Rica experiment)
In Kenya, carcasses lasted nearly three times longer and mammal scavengers tripled when vultures were kept away
Feral dog numbers rose in India as vultures vanished
Dogs cause the vast majority of human rabies cases; India accounts for roughly a third of global rabies deaths
Rabies vaccine sales rose in districts that lost their vultures
One study estimates death rates rose about 4.7% in vulture-rich districts: roughly 100,000 extra deaths a year, about half a million from 2000 to 2005
notes: Must be framed as an estimate

claim_as_used_in_script: The same study puts the cost at about 69 billion dollars a year
Vultures' harsh stomach acid and specialised gut bacteria let them eat meat that would sicken most animals
A Rüppell's vulture was hit by a plane at 11,300 metres over Ivory Coast in 1973
A group of vultures can strip a large carcass in about half an hour
Parsi Towers of Silence relied on vultures; solar concentrators were installed but struggle in the monsoon
In Spain, trucking carcasses away produces about 77,000 tonnes of CO2 a year
Africa: eight vulture species fell 62% on average; seven by 80% or more over three generations; poisoning and belief-based use cause 90% of reported deaths
Other scavengers can't fully replace vultures
If fewer than one carcass in a hundred carried a lethal dose of diclofenac, that alone could explain the crash
Some poachers poison elephant carcasses so circling vultures don't reveal the kill; in one Namibian case around 500 vultures died at a single carcass
notes: Reported by Smithsonian / Yale e360 / BBC Wildlife

claim_as_used_in_script: Nepal set up 'vulture restaurants' (diclofenac-free feeding stations, first at Pithauli in 2007); nesting white-rumped vultures increased at nearby colonies
Meloxicam is a painkiller for livestock that does not harm vultures
Three South Asian vulture species (white-rumped, Indian, slender-billed) are listed as critically endangered
notes: IUCN Red List status per BirdLife / Mongabay
